page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page, with Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words set in their own script at the start of entries. Page number and running head at the top. Signature "FFff" at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: מִשּׁוּמְשָׁנָא Ch. Idem, Numer. 11. 28. 2. Sam. 13. 17. Plur. cum Aff. מִשּׁוּמְשָׁנוֹי Ministri ejus, Esth. 6. 3.
ܡܫܡܫܢܐ Syr. Idem. Plur. ܡܫܡܫܢܐ Fœmin. ܡܫܡܫܢܐ Ministra, ad Rom. 16. 1.
שַׁמָּשׁ Ch. Idem, Plur. שַׁמָּשִׁי שַׁמָּשִׁין, Jesa. 6. 2. 6. Ita Paraphrastes transfert Hebr. שְׂרָפִים Seraphim. Fœmin. שַׁמָּשָׁא, Plur. שַׁמָּשַׁין, 1. Sam. 8. 13.
שַׁמּוּשׁ Ch. Ministerium, officium, עַל סְרַר שַׁמּוּשִׁי In ordinem officii mei, Genes. 41. 13. in Jon.
שַׁמְשָׁא, Ch. ܫܡܫܐ Syr. Sol, quòd Lumen mundo subministret. Plur. שַׁמְשַׁיָּא, שַׁמְשִׁין.
תִּשְׁמִישְׁתָּא, תִּשְׁמִישָׁא, תִּשְׁמִישׁ Ch. Congressus, coitus, concubitus. Plur. תִּשְׁמִישִׁין.
שׁוּמְשְׁמָנָא Ch. Formica, Prov. 6. 6. plur. constr. שׁוּמְשְׁמָנֵי Formicæ, Prov. 30. 25.

שְׁמַתָּא Ch. Schammata, Excommunicationis species. Occurrit aliquoties in Targum, Cant. 2. 16. Num. 21. 25. in Jon. Gen. 42. 37. in eodem, ut & Deut. 7. 2. & 13. 18. Plur. שְׁמָתִין, Deut. 7. 26. in Jon.

שְׁנָה Chal. Iterare; secundo facere, Proverb. 17. 9. Mutari, immutari, variari: Syris, Mutari mente, insanire. Pahel שַׁנִּי Ch. Mutare, immutare, permutare, variare: Syris ܫܢܝ Mutare locum, discedere, secedere, migrare, transfire: loco movere, transferre, 1. ad Cor. 13. 2. Ithpahel אִשְׁתַּנִּי Mutari, immutari: Mutare se, mutatum, diversum se ostendere

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; vowel points and some Syriac forms are approximate. The last line continues onto the next page.
